text: The list of applicants and the relevant details of the applications are set out in the appended table.
The applicants complained of the ban on holding lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender (LGBT) public assemblies imposed by the domestic authorities.
The applicants complained of the discriminatory manner in which the domestic authorities treated their applications for holding lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender (LGBT) public events.
In application no. 13518/10, Mr Sutyagin raised a complaint about the lack of domestic remedies against the alleged violation of his right to freedom of assembly.
